summary: US equities rebounded sharply on Nov 23 after Friday's sell-off left the S&P 500 in correction; the S&P 500 closed +4.73% at 7,237 and the Nasdaq Composite +6.51% at 24,090. Nvidia rose 31.48% to $165.05 after its board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, lifting AI and chip names; US futures were modestly higher Monday evening. Bitcoin was about $61,134 on Nov 23, slightly up on the day but well below mid-November levels. Upcoming risk: US consumer confidence (Nov 24), Dell earnings (Nov 24), October core PCE and Q3 GDP (Nov 25) in a holiday-shortened week, and an OPEC+ meeting on Nov 29. No dated last-72h items were found for non-US central banks, FX, gold, Ether, Amazon, oil inventories, or the DAX/FTSE/Nikkei.
